actions.action: If brown tips bother you, trim them with clean scissors, leaving a thin brown border
Remove fully yellow, fully brown or mostly dead leaves by cutting the petiole, leaving a 1-2 cm stub
If there are spreading fungal lesions, remove the affected leaves promptly
If there are fungal lesions, move the plant to a spot with better ventilation
Clean snips with rubbing alcohol between plants
Dispose of diseased leaves in general waste rather than compost

verdict.reason: This generic leaf-removal guide mentions low humidity only in passing as a common cause of brown tips and never advises raising humidity or moving the plant, though its trimming advice is not harmful.
